verdict.rationale: USPTO is a government filing and data service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The pack documents only adjacent machine surfaces, which do not count toward this story: an API-key-gated api.uspto.gov, a developer portal that renders only with JavaScript, and direct API calls to Patent Center Workbench.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
